author: Decent
name: Shot companion
description: Adds to the Streamline dashboard: the current bean in the top bar, a live shot strip in the info row while an espresso runs, and last-shot pills on Grind, Dose and Drink that restore what you used last time.

LiveStrip.label: Live shot strip
LiveStrip.description: While an espresso runs, replace the info row with weight against target, pressure and flow against the profile, the current step and today's shot number.

LastShotPills.label: Last-shot pills
LastShotPills.description: Show the grind, dose and yield of your last matching shot under the Grind, Dose and Drink tiles. Tap a pill to use that value again.

BeanButton.label: Current bean button
BeanButton.description: Show the current coffee's name in the top bar. Tap it for the roast date, beans left and the last shot with that coffee.

MatchBy.label: Last shot of
MatchBy.description: Which earlier shot the pills recall. Same coffee uses the coffee name on the workflow and falls back to the profile when there is none.

what.description: Always "skin": only this plugin's skin answer changed.
